cat > /usr/local/sbin/fleet-https-server.py <<'PYEOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import http.server
import ssl

BODY = b"node2 Fleet Internal CA HTTPS service\n"

class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(BODY)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(BODY)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        super().log_message(fmt, *args)

server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8443), Handler)
context = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
context.minimum_version = ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_2
context.load_cert_chain("/etc/fleet-https/node2.crt", "/etc/fleet-https/node2.key")
server.socket = context.wrap_socket(server.socket, server_side=True)
server.serve_forever()
PYEOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/fleet-https-server.py
cat > /etc/systemd/system/fleet-https.service <<'UNITEOF'
